name: Bharti Airtel Ltd.
business_summary: India's second-largest mobile operator (premium ARPU Rs264 in Q1 FY27; 681m customers across 15 countries incl. ~14 in Africa), with fixed broadband/DTH, enterprise (Airtel Business, Nxtra data centres) and a 50% stake in Indus Towers (model knowledge). Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs58,539 cr (+18.4% y/y), EBITDA Rs33.6k cr (57.4%), PAT Rs10.0k cr. Q2 FY27 results are due 2026-11-05 (today). Key themes: tariff repair (Oct-2026 postpaid +Rs50), Jio IPO (Rs30,213 cr), 5G monetisation, Africa growth.

cost_structure.input: network opex incl. energy and tower rentals

exposures.mechanism: India mobile revenue ~Rs1.2 lakh cr annualised (Q1 FY27 India business Rs41.2k cr/qtr, mobile ~75%); +10% ARPU = ~+Rs12k cr/yr at ~100% drop-through vs TTM consolidated EBITDA Rs1.25 lakh cr => +9.8% EBITDA; EV/MCap ~1.17 (net debt incl. leases ~Rs2 lakh cr, model estimate); persistence 0.5 => +5.7, trimmed to +5.5 as the Oct-2026 postpaid hike (+Rs50) is partly priced. Pack has no tariff proxy.
